question: Which option in the print dialog allows you to save a web page as a digital file instead of printing it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Save as PDF**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The "Save as PDF" option in the print dialog allows users to save a web page as a PDF file instead of physically printing it.

• This option is commonly available in most modern web browsers and operating systems.

• It is a convenient way to store digital copies of web pages for offline viewing or sharing.

• Using this option helps in reducing paper usage and is environmentally friendly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Print Preview**

• This option allows users to see how the web page will look when printed, including layout, page breaks, and other print settings.

• It is useful for ensuring that the printed output matches the user's expectations before committing to printing.

• **Print to File**

• This option allows users to save the print job as a file, typically in a format like PostScript or PDF.

• It is useful for creating a digital copy of the print job that can be printed later or on a different printer.

• **Select Printer**

• This option allows users to choose which printer they want to use for printing the web page.

• It is helpful when multiple printers are available, and the user needs to select the appropriate one for the job.
